{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:45.619

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:51.380

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:53.619

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:00.579
    | text      = Trump is doing what he has to do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:02.900
    | text      = And on this, I 100% supporting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:05.380
    | text      = So that's a fundamental betrayal of everything Alex is supposed to stand for.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:08.980
    | text      = Literally everything, every single one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:11.859
    | text      = Trump is attempting to whip up support for his idea of federalizing the police in Washington,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:16.259
    | text      = DC.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:16.819
    | text      = And the only justifiable way to argue in favor of this is technicalities involving the home
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:22.900
    | text      = rule act of 1973.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:25.700
    | text      = DC isn't a city and it's not a state.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:28.099
    | text      = So it doesn't fit the same mold as other municipalities in terms of offering its residents full self-government.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:33.140
    | text      = They have a mayor who acts similar to a state's governor and their council is their legislature.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:39.059
    | text      = But because the center of the government is there, the federal folks have an outsized
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:43.539
    | text      = influence.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:44.660
    | text      = Congress has to sign off on all the bills that the council passes and the president
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:48.420
    | text      = retains a lot of powers that would normally go to a governor like taking over the police
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:53.059
    | text      = in the case of an emergency.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:55.460
    | text      = Section 740 of the home rule act allows the president to take over the municipal police
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:00.019
    | text      = department if there's an emergency, but also they're only supposed to be able to do that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:04.019
    | text      = for 48 hours.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:05.779
    | text      = By that point, the president is required to justify the use of force to Congress unless
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:10.259
    | text      = Congress is adjourned when they do it, in which case they have 30 days.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:14.660
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:15.140
    | text      = It may surprise you to learn that Trump invoked this while Congress was adjourned.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:18.019
    | text      = Huh?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:18.500
    | text      = How about that?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:19.220
    | text      = So in the real world, crime is down significantly in DC.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:22.420
    | text      = So it doesn't seem like there would be a good argument to say that this was an emergency
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:26.500
    | text      = that required this kind of action.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:28.099
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:28.660
    | text      = But that didn't stop the Trump administration from pretending that everything was out of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:32.420
    | text      = control.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:33.460
    | text      = On August 11th, after Trump officially took over the MPD, the White House published a
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:38.339
    | text      = statement titled, quote, fact, yes, DC crime is out of control.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:43.859
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:44.420
    | text      = It begins, quote, Washington DC should be a symbol of pride and patriotism for the American
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:49.539
    | text      = people and a safe location for tourists, residents, and public servants.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:53.619
    | text      = Unfortunately, while fake news, journalists, and politicians go out of their way to claim
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:57.859
    | text      = otherwise, the reality is that our nation's capital is anything but safe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:02.579
    | text      = That tone is not what I love to see.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:05.859
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:06.819
    | text      = So the first thing they cite in this statement is a study from the Rochester Institute of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:11.380
    | text      = Technology, which they accurately claim shows DC having a murder rate of 27.3 people per
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:17.859
    | text      = 100,000 residents.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:19.140
    | text      = Uh-huh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:19.940
    | text      = In the very next sentence, they use this study again to claim that DC has the, quote, fourth
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:25.220
    | text      = highest homicide rate in the country.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:27.380
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:28.339
    | text      = This is based on that same study in that, and it was correct based on that, that DC
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:34.579
    | text      = is the fourth highest among the municipalities that that paper looked at.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:38.579
    | text      = But that title, the title of that study is, quote, 2024 homicide statistics for 24 US
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:44.339
    | text      = cities.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:45.460
    | text      = Their data only included 24 cities, which were selected because they were the same cities
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:50.180
    | text      = that this professor, Irshad Ulfheimer, used when they did the same analysis in 2019 and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:56.180
    | text      = 2020.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:56.900
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:57.460
    | text      = This paper isn't about homicide rates full stop.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:00.660
    | text      = It's really about homicide rates in Rochester, New York, and how they compare to trends and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
